faq.question: Which EV is practical under ₹10 lakh ex-showroom?
faq.answer: Our list filters Tier-1 catalog variants at or below ₹10 lakh ex-showroom, then orders by ownership-value composite scores — not paid placements.

faq.question: Should I rely only on ex-showroom price?
faq.answer: No. On-road price varies by city (registration, insurance). Use ex-showroom as a comparison anchor and confirm on-road quotes locally.

faq.question: What is the top pick on this page?
faq.answer: Mg Play is currently highest on our budget under 10 composite (score 74, medium confidence). This is not a universal "best EV" claim — review tradeoffs below.

faq.question: What is the ex-showroom price of Mg Play?
faq.answer: Indicative ex-showroom from catalog: ₹7.98 lakh. Confirm on-road price with a dealer in your city.
